title: DragonFly release signing request
description: Request emitted by the release pipeline for an external/human signer to produce a signed release tag.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this request document.

release_tag.description: Tag to create, e.g. v6.6.0 or v6.6.0rc1.

release_branch.description: Release branch the tag is cut from, e.g. DragonFly_RELEASE_6_6.

release_stage.description: Whether this is a release candidate or a final release.

rc_number.description: RC sequence number; only meaningful when release_stage is rc.

commit.description: Full 40-hex commit object id the tag must point to.

origin_url.description: Origin the release is being cut against.

created.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the request was generated.

jenkins_build.description: Jenkins build identifier that produced this request.
